import cmath


def angle_complex(a, b):
    """Write a function to get the angle of a complex number.

    Return the phase, in radians in (-pi, pi], of the complex number
    formed by ``a`` and ``b``. ``b`` may be given either as the real
    imaginary part (``angle_complex(1, 1)``) or as an imaginary term
    (``angle_complex(1, 1j)``); ``a`` may likewise already be complex,
    in which case the number is the sum ``a + b``.
    """
    if isinstance(a, complex) or isinstance(b, complex):
        z = complex(a) + complex(b)
    else:
        z = complex(a, b)
    return cmath.phase(z)
